item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyad ma 'ong lung bstan mtsho rgyal ma'i zhus len nges pa'i snying po
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan ces pa'i lcags mo phag lo'i zla 1 tshes ” nyin par la/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas kyi ri bo'i byang phyogs ge ta brag ces bya ba nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas rigs ldan karma Dak+ki bde ldan mas grogs mdzad cing spyan drangs pa lags shing / slar bsod nams can gyi stobs kyi rgyal po sa skyongs mi dbang chen po'i pho brang rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse la/ mkha' 'gro'i brda yig bod yig tu phab grub pa bgyis so/ gsang ba theg chen bstan pa'i 'gro don phyogs bcur rgyas shing yun ring gnas par gyur cig/
